categories.main_business_segments: Gree Electric Appliances operates primarily in two major sectors: consumer home appliances and industrial equipment. Its consumer segment includes home air conditioners, HVAC systems, refrigerators, washing machines, water heaters, kitchen appliances, environmental appliances, smart buildings, and smart home products. The industrial segment covers high-end equipment, precision molds, refrigeration and freezing equipment, motors, compressors, capacitors, semiconductor devices, precision casting, basic materials, industrial energy storage, and recycling resources.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technology self-development with a strong R&D system including national-level research platforms. Key technologies include AI-driven energy-saving air conditioning, advanced compressor and motor designs, magnetic levitation motor systems, and integrated IoT platforms for smart homes. Manufacturing incorporates intelligent automation, CNC machining, industrial robots, and digital factory systems, ensuring high-quality and efficient production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gree serves a broad customer base including individual consumers, commercial enterprises, public infrastructure projects, and industrial clients. Its products are used in residential, commercial, industrial, and public sectors such as large-scale HVAC installations, data centers, transportation hubs, and cold chain logistics. The company also targets global markets with tailored products for diverse climatic and regulatory environments.
categories.geographic_coverage: Gree operates extensively across China with production bases in Guangdong, Chongqing, Anhui, and other provinces, as well as overseas facilities in Brazil. Its products are sold in over 190 countries and regions worldwide, with significant market presence in Europe, North America, Latin America, Africa, and Asia. The company maintains a global sales and service network including numerous overseas stores and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gree operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, encompassing product design, core component manufacturing (compressors, motors, semiconductors), assembly, and distribution. It controls key upstream components through subsidiaries and strategic acquisitions, ensuring vertical integration and supply chain stability. The company also manages recycling and resource recovery, completing a circular supply chain loop.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, and smart technologies. R&D focuses include AI-driven dynamic energy-saving control, advanced refrigeration and heating technologies, smart home IoT integration, and industrial automation. Gree actively participates in international and national standards development and invests in patent cultivation and technology breakthroughs to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Gree generates revenue primarily through product sales of consumer and industrial appliances. It also earns income from after-sales services, licensing of proprietary technologies, and investments. The company leverages both offline retail networks and online platforms, including direct e-commerce sales and third-party marketplaces, to maximize market reach and sales efficiency.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gree is a leading player in the Chinese and global home appliance markets, especially in air conditioning where it holds the top domestic market share and ranks first globally in split air conditioner retail volume. It competes with other major domestic and international appliance manufacturers. Its strong brand, technological innovation, and quality assurance position it as an industry benchmark and market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gree reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 190 billion, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 32.18 billion, reflecting a 10.91% year-over-year profit growth despite a slight revenue decline. The company maintains substantial total assets exceeding RMB 368 billion and net assets over RMB 137 billion, demonstrating robust financial scale and steady profitability growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gree emphasizes superior product quality, energy efficiency, and technological innovation as its core value propositions. It offers differentiated products with advanced AI energy-saving features, environmentally friendly refrigerants, and smart home integration. The company’s PQAM perfect quality assurance model and extended warranty services reinforce consumer trust. Its comprehensive product portfolio and global service network deliver high-quality, reliable, and intelligent solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.
